newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Credit Lyonnais HK branch sets HK$1.0 bln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais HK branch sets HK$1.0 bln FRCD.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais, acting through its Hong Kong branch, has launched a HK$1.0 billion a floating rate certificates of deposit (FRCD) issue due May 5, 2000, arranger HSBC Markets said on Wednesday.
The three-year certificates were priced at par to pay a coupon of 32 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. (HIBOR) There are no puts or calls.

With fees, the all-in return is 40 basis points to top-tier participants. Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the certificates for use at its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
